# Villa Koukouvayia Farms

> Villa Koukouvayia Farms (Villa K) is a private three-residence coastal estate among the olive groves of western Crete, Greece, above the Gulf of Kissamos. It hosts holidays, remote work-stays, retreat programmes and destination celebrations such as weddings and family reunions. The hosts, Heidi and Richard Palola-Harriman, live on the estate year-round and have welcomed guests since 2019. "Koukouvayia" is Greek for "owl".

- Address: Agricultural Road #1, Kourthiana, Kissamos 73400, Crete, Greece
- Residences: The Main House (3 bedrooms, up to 9 guests), The Guest House (up to 6), The Garden Suite (up to 13). Book one, combine two, or take the entire estate for groups of 20 or more.
- Shared: olive groves and walking trails, a deep plunge pool with a toddler's waterfall, roof terraces for star-gazing, sea views, high-speed internet and a proper office for remote work.
- Check-in 16:00, check-out 10:00. Prices in EUR. The hosts' dog Logan lives on site.
- Book direct on this website (enquiry form with an instant price estimate), or via Airbnb and VRBO.
- Contact: info@koukouvayia.com

## Cretan Destination Retreats

The hosts also run Cretan Destination Retreats ("Retreat, Play, Love"): small-group programmes on Crete and in mainland Greece, capped at twelve guests, mostly lodged at the estate. Programmes include a collaborative photography retreat, an advanced Lefka Ori (White Mountains) trek, "Cities of History, Mountains of Myth" (Thessaloniki and Mount Olympus) and the Cretan olive harvest season. Custom programmes on request. Current dates and prices: https://koukouvayia.com/retreats
